description: This file defines enumerations, a struct, and a resolver function related to determining the effective connection mode for an application, based on configuration data, remote URL, user defaults, or onboarding status.

classes.name: EffectiveConnectionMode
classes.description: A struct representing the application's connection mode along with its source.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Determines the effective connection mode based on provided configuration, remote URL, user defaults, or onboarding status.
